thread:
Maya: hey team — i'm stuck on the train, won't make the midnight handoff. need someone to take primary for 00:00-04:00 UTC. there's a scheduled model deploy ~00:45 UTC that can trigger noisy cold starts. if no primary we risk delayed pager responses. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handovers and deploy note: https://confluence.redwood/deploys/2026-03-midnight-quant.json. sry for the short notice :disappointed:

oncall-rotation-bot: Primary Maya removed from shift by scheduler; next oncall list: Tara -> Liam -> Jon. Use `/oncall claim` to take primary. :robot_face:

Liam: I can be backup/shadow for the first hour (00:00-01:00 UTC). can't take full primary, have a personal thing at 01:15 — happy to pick up pages until then.

Jon: heads-up — the deploy is a hotfix to batching config, may cause a brief token storm. runbook step 'deploy-fallback' applies. snippet: ```rollback: ./scripts/rollback_batch.sh```

Tara: I can take primary if someone shares last 2 pager contexts and quick handoff notes. @Maya can you paste any open customer tickets or P0s? i'll join bridge at 23:50 to sync.

Maya: copying last two pager contexts: cust-A — embedding spikes at 00:03 last night, cust-B — KV cache eviction flapping. no P0s open. added a short note in runbook: "train delay — handing off to Tara".

sre-bot: PAGERS (summary): 3 alerts in last 24h — embed-latency > 500ms (x2), kv-evict-frequency high (x1). incident link: https://sre.incidents/1745. Recommended action if primary: follow 'eviction-reset' in runbook.

Liam: noted. Tara if you take it i'll shadow and handle pages until 01:00.

Tara: ok taking primary. `/oncall claim --primary @Tara`. i'll be primary 00:00-04:00 UTC. joining bridge in ~8m. ping me in thread for any ephemeral creds.

oncall-rotation-bot: Claim registered. Primary: Tara. Secondary: Liam. Handoff logged (Maya -> Tara).

Tara: ping @Maya for any ephemeral tokens or access. @Liam please confirm you have jumpbox creds. runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-fallback#eviction-reset

Maya: shared jumpbox credentials via 1Password to Tara and Liam. left short notes in the oncall runbook page.

Jon: if we see a KV eviction spike after the deploy run: ```curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/kv/reset -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"force":true}'``` — and escalate to infra if evictions persist beyond 5m.

Tara: thanks all. i'll monitor the canary window and escalate as needed. i'll also enable tighter paging thresholds during the deploy window. :thumbsup:

oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy in 40m. Canary window 00:45-01:05 UTC. Auto-fallback configured to model-quant-v2.

Liam: setting an alert watch and keeping my phone on. good luck, team.

Maya: thanks everyone for the quick coverage, leaving the thread with a short note: 'train delay -> Tara primary, Liam shadow until 01:00'.
